description: Cases the reference Go runner is expected to fail against the Go core commit named by pin, each with the failure signature the runner prints and the reason. Spec CI compares the runner's results with this file (scripts/check-runner-results.mjs): an unexpected failure, an expected failure that passes or is not run, a changed signature, and a pin other than the one the job checked out all fail CI. The pin is the Go commit this corpus was built against. The job that reads this file stays disabled until integration publishes that commit, or the commit that adopts this corpus, and the pin and these failures are keyed to it.
